conclusion: Recorded run 4b53d86a's demonstration in the guard ledger. harness/departments/guard_ledger.py's entry for 'scripts/make_context.py --check' moves fired=None -> fired=True, demonstrated_by=hunts/r_414eed/probe.py (24 mutants, 17/17 in scope caught), with scope rewritten to the invariant the probe actually found — 'CONTEXT.md is a byte-exact function of the scanned tree' rather than 'the public API index is current' — and known_misses=() replaced by the six non-firing rows of RESULTS.md's boundary table: B06 (private helper renamed public in place, length-neutral, in an __all__-declaring module: the one miss inside the guard's own subject matter), B01 meta/, B02 compiler/, B03 docs/doors/, B04 non-test_*.py test files, B07 docstring below its first line. tests/test_guard_ledger.py's worklist assertion is inverted in the same commit, and its artifact-existence check extended to cover demonstrations that live outside tests/ (the ledger previously only checked cited nodes in its own file, so a fired=True carrying a nonexistent path would have gone unchecked). hunts/README.md gains the Hunt #9 case-log entry. Refused, and this is the one thing left undone: regenerating CONTEXT.md. Amending the ledger changes harness/departments/guard_ledger.py's length from 192 to 229 lines, and CONTEXT.md prints a per-module line count, so 'scripts/make_context.py --check' now exits 1 on this branch. The whole regeneration diff is that single '*192 lines*' -> '*229 lines*' field. CONTEXT.md is a root markdown file and this brief's permissions exclude it, so it is left stale and reported rather than written. It is also, unplanned, a live instance of the mechanism the amended entry names: the guard fired on the commit that recorded it, by accounting rather than by comprehension. Nothing was re-run of the probe itself; nothing here bears on RH, and the guard is not claimed correct — it fired against a sample of 24 mutants.
confidence: Lean on fired=True and on the six known misses: each is a row in hunts/r_414eed/results.json carrying a process exit code, under two controls (unmutated sandbox reproduces CONTEXT.md byte for byte; undo re-checked after all 24 mutants). Lean on the scope sentence too — it is the probe's mechanism finding (M01 fires with token_in_diff=false, B08 fires on a blank line), not an interpretation. Lean less on completeness: 24 mutants is a sample, not an enumeration, so known_misses is a floor on the guard's blind set, not a bound. Whether the four unscanned regions are defects or design is still nobody's recorded decision, and the entry deliberately states them as facts about the globs rather than as faults. tests/test_guard_ledger.py and tests/test_hunt_probe_discipline.py both pass, 16 tests, on a venv carrying pytest/mpmath/numpy and the editable install only (scipy and matplotlib were not needed and not installed; python-flint was not installed, so nothing here exercised the rigor cross-check and nothing here needed to).
operator_decision_required: CONTEXT.md is stale on this branch by exactly one line ('*192 lines*' -> '*229 lines*' under harness/departments/guard_ledger.py). Any branch that touches a scanned file inherits this; it is not specific to the ledger edit.
